AX-11
AUTOMATIC TAANSAXLE (U341E) - VALVE BODY ASSEMBLY
14. INSTALL CHECK VALVE ANO SPRING
p
15. INSTALL VALVE BODY
(a) Align the groove of the manual valve with the pin of the
manual valve lever.
(b) Temporarily install the valve body with the 12 bolts.
Bolt length:
Bolt A: 55 mm (2.17 In.)
Bolt B: 45 mm (1.n in.)
Bolt C: 32 mm (1.26 in.)
Bolt D: 22 mm (0.87 in.)
{c) Temporarily install the detent spring and cover with the 3
bolts.
Bolt length:
Bolt 8: 45 mm (1.n in.)
Bolt C: 32 mm (1.26 in.}
Bolt E: 14 mm (0.55 in.)
(d) Check that the manual valve lever contacts the center ot
the roller at the tip of the detent spring.
(e) Tighten the 15 bolts.
Torque: 11 N.m (110 kgf-cm, 8 ft-lbf)
16. INSTALL ATF TEMPERATURE SENSOR
Install the ATF temperature sensor with the lock plate and bolt.
Torque: 10 N-m (100 kgt-cm, 8 ft,lbf)
17. CONNECT 5 SHIFT SOLENOID VALVE CONNECTORS
18. INSTALL OIL STRAINER
(a) Coat a new 0-ring with ATF.
(b) Install the 0-ring to the oil strainer.
